name: a_econ_data
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Economic data.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Every US economic release on the session date and the brief date through the cutoff (PMIs, jobless claims, durable goods, housing, GDP, inflation, sentiment): actual vs consensus vs prior, and release time.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PPI** [Macro / Calendar]
- September Producer Price Index for final demand rose **1.3% month over month** versus **0.5% consensus** and **0.4% prior**; the index rose **6.3% year over year** versus **5.3% consensus** and **5.4% prior**. Core PPI rose **0.7% month over month** versus **0.3% consensus** and **5.0% year over year** versus **4.4% consensus**, compared with **0.2%** and **4.6%** previously. Released at **08:30 ET on Oct. 15** (Investrade, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[5]
- PPI final-demand prices increased **1.3% in September**, the largest monthly increase since March 2022; August’s increase was revised to **0.5%** from **0.4%** (Reuters, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[3]

## Retail Sales [Macro / Calendar]
- September retail sales increased **0.8% month over month** versus **0.3% consensus** and **1.2% prior**; retail sales excluding autos rose **0.9%** versus **0.5% consensus** and **1.4% prior**. The control group rose **0.1%** versus **0.3% consensus** and **1.2% prior**. Released at **08:30 ET on Oct. 15** (Investrade, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[5]
- Retail sales increased **0.8% in September** after a **1.3% rise in August**; the increase was reported by the Census Bureau (Reuters, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[3]

## Jobless Claims [Macro / Calendar]
- Initial unemployment claims increased to **199,000** for the week ended Oct. 10 versus **200,000 consensus** and **198,000 prior**; the four-week moving average rose to **198,500** from **198,250**, while continuing claims fell to **1.710 million** from **1.714 million**. Released at **08:30 ET on Oct. 15** (Investrade, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[5]
- Initial claims increased by **1,000 to 199,000**, according to the Labor Department (Reuters, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[3]

## Empire State Manufacturing [Macro / Calendar]
- The New York Fed’s October Empire State current business conditions index rose to **25.5** versus **10.25 consensus** and **7.6 prior**; the six-month conditions index fell to **21.0** from **29.0**. Released at **08:30 ET on Oct. 15** (Investrade, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[5]

## Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing [Macro / Calendar]
- The Philadelphia Fed’s October Business Outlook index fell to **20.9** versus **28.4 consensus** and **37.8 prior**; new orders fell to **4.3** from **29.2**, and the six-month conditions index fell to **33.0** from **52.9**. Released at **08:30 ET on Oct. 15** (Investrade, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[5]

## Import and Export Prices [Macro / Calendar]
- The scheduled U.S. import and export price indexes were listed for **08:30 ET on Oct. 16**, but no actual, consensus, or prior values were available in the retrieved results by the **02:03 ET cutoff** (MarketAlleys, Oct. 15 publication time not specified)[10]
